surfaces.currentBehavior: Comment-only corrected READY scaffold for exact scope-bound operation, attachment queue and vault-orphan observation with serialized transactional journaling, post-commit revalidation and durable stable summary evidence.
surfaces.notes: No executable behavior before exact READY review and immutable CI.

securityRequirements: Validate environment, Principal and Account scope and every observed row before returning a summary
Database, attachment, journal, malformed, orphaned, overflow or concurrent-mutation failures never become authoritative zero
syncRequirements: Count queued, applying and unresolved-rejected local operations plus every still-present unverified attachment
Preserve stable observation identity across unchanged reads and encrypted restart while advancing monotonically on any evidence change

migration.rule: Read only disposable target-local evidence; import no Firebase cache, pending write, media or session state.
reconciliation: Summary counts and identity digest reconcile exactly to validated local operation and attachment evidence

acceptance: Exact counts, terminal exclusion, stable/monotonic observation, restart, scope and failure behavior pass without physical session ending

securityRequirements: Unknown, null, malformed and cross-scope evidence fails closed

syncRequirements: Tests distinguish local operation lifecycle state, ps_crud transport work and attachment durability evidence

acceptance: All local provider obligations pass before implementation status advances
